column1: # UK Border Systems Map - Editable Configuration
# Edit any section below. Save as .csv. Drag the file onto the app to load it.
# Sections start with a line like `# SECTION: <name>`.
# The first row of each section is the column header.
# Lines starting with # are comments and are ignored.
# id        - unique stream identifier (referenced from nodes)
# short     - short label shown on the map row header (uppercase)
# color     - hex colour for the stream (e.g. #60a5fa)
# id    - stage identifier (referenced from nodes). Stages render as columns left-to-right in CSV order.
# label - column header text on the map
# color       - fill colour for nodes of this category (hex)
# text_color  - label text colour (hex). Pick a high-contrast value relative to the fill.
# Default elasticities used when an edge's `elasticity` cell is empty.
# Elasticity = percent change in target value per percent change in source value.
# id           - unique node identifier (referenced from edges)
# label        - display name on the node
# description  - tooltip text and detail panel description
# stream       - which stream this node belongs to (must match an id in `streams` section)
# stage        - which stage column this node sits in (must match an id in `stages` section)
# category     - node category (must match an id in `categories` section)
# baseline     - baseline numeric value (e.g. 9000 for FTE
# unit         - unit string shown after the value (e.g. FTE
# controllable - 'true' to expose this node as a slider in Simulation mode; blank otherwise
